Package theknife.obj.restaurant

Class Location

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.restaurant.Coordinate
theknife.obj.restaurant.Location
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Restaurant
public class Location extends Coordinate
A class that represents a geographic location, extending Coordinate.

This class adds information about the country, city, and address to the basic geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) provided by Coordinate.
It can be used to represent the location of a restaurant or other geographic entities.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)
